meta_note: All routes are prefixed with /api/account. Most routes are protected by ApiGuard (JWT bearer). The Mono webhook route is public but protected by MonoGuard (HMAC signature verification).

getLinkedAccounts.description: Return all Mono bank accounts linked to the authenticated user.

syncAccount.description: Manually trigger a transaction sync for a specific linked bank account. Enqueues a SYNC_ACCOUNT_JOB on the MONO_QUEUE; the sync is processed asynchronously.

monoWebhook.description: Receive Mono webhook events (e.g. mono.events.account_updated, mono.events.reauthorisation_required). This route is public but protected by MonoGuard which verifies the Mono-Signature HMAC header. Supported events trigger a sync or status update for the relevant account.
monoWebhook.authentication: MonoGuard — verifies Mono-Signature HMAC header (not a user JWT)

linkMonoAccount.description: Link a new Mono bank account to the authenticated user using the one-time code from the Mono Connect widget. Exchanges the code for an account token, fetches account details, and persists the linked account.

input.code: string (required) — one-time code from the Mono Connect widget

responses.500: Internal server error or Mono API failure

relinkMonoAccount.description: Re-link an existing Mono bank account after a reauthorisation event (e.g. password change on the user's bank). Uses the reauth code from the Mono Connect widget to refresh the account token.

input.code: string (required) — reauth code from the Mono Connect widget
input.accountId: string (required) — MonoBankAccount database ID to relink

responses.500: Internal server error or Mono API failure
